Mandibulate_Shearing_Maws.description: Massive, laterally-moving chitinous mandibles powered by huge adductor muscles taking up most of the head capsule. They operate like biological bolt-cutters, designed to shear through tough vegetation, bone, and foreign exoskeletons with equal ease.

Haustellate_Piercing_Proboscis.description: A highly elongated, needle-like rostrum containing interlocking stylets. Instead of chewing, the entity pierces deep into host tissue, injecting salivary anticoagulants and digestive enzymes before sucking the liquefied contents back up.
